indication_area: Drug-resistant Gram-negative bacterial infections (complicated urinary tract infections; hospital-acquired and ventilator-associated bacterial pneumonia)
revenue_scope: Fetroja line under Shionogi Inc. (U.S. subsidiary) in Shionogi's Revenue by Segment table
geography: United States (the table's Shionogi Inc. section; Shionogi's FY2025 Q1 presentation labels it 'ShionogiInc. (US)')

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 209445 NDA APPROVAL ... FETROJA (cefiderocol) for injection ... This new drug application provides for the use of FETROJA (cefiderocol) for injection

series_start_reason: Fetroja launched in the U.S. in February 2020 (FY2019 Q4, calendar 2020Q1). The first quarter a figure can be read for is FY2020 Q1 (April-June 2020 = 2020Q2), from the prior-year column of the FY2021 Q1 presentation. FY2019 is printed only as a full year, 0.0 B yen (prior-year column of the FY2020 results presentation e_210510.pdf), so calendar 2020Q1 has no figure above the table's precision and the series starts at 2020Q2. The FY2020 Q1, Q2 and Q3 presentations (e-P-200731.pdf, e_201102.pdf, e_210201.pdf) print Shionogi Inc. but no Fetroja line.
notes: Shionogi prints the Fetroja line only as a fiscal year-to-date cumulative figure (three, six, nine or twelve months from April). Each fiscal Q1 row is the three-month figure read directly; each later quarter is that document's cumulative figure less the previous quarter's cumulative figure (year_to_date_less_reported_quarters), with the previous figure's document named in the quote. Figures are billions of yen to one decimal, so a derived quarter carries up to 0.1 B yen (100 million yen) of rounding. FY2020 cumulative figures (0.1, 0.4, 0.9) are the prior-year columns of the FY2021 Q1-Q3 presentations; the FY2020 twelve-month figure 1.7 is read from the FY2020 results presentation itself. Cross-checks: each fiscal year's quarters sum to the twelve-month figure by construction, and every prior-year column checked agrees with the figure printed the year before (e.g. FY2023 presentations print FY2022 as 1.8, 4.7, 7.3, 10.0). European sales are a separate Fetcroja line (Shionogi B.V.) and are not included; Japanese sales are not in this line. The FY2026 Q1 transcript states 'U.S. sales of Fetroja totaled ¥7.7 billion', matching 2026Q2. Replaces the annual series shionogi_fetroja_annual.csv (fiscal years 2019-2025).
search_log: Fetched shionogi.com/global/en/investors/ir-library/presentation-materials.html and financial-results-supplement.html, downloaded all 210 English PDFs linked there from FY2015 onward (presentations, supplements, tanshin, transcripts) and extracted every page with pdfplumber; listed every line containing Fetroja or Fetcroja per document.

Fetroja line with figures found in each quarterly results presentation from FY2021 Q1 (e_wide_1Q..._20210802_final.pdf) to FY2026 Q1 (E_FY2026_1Q_...pdf), and in the FY2020 results presentation (e_210510.pdf); columns are forecast(s), cumulative results, achievement %, prior-year cumulative results, change %, change.

FY2020 Q1-Q3 presentations (e-P-200731.pdf, e_201102.pdf/e_201030.pdf, e_210201.pdf) and supplements sup20_10.pdf, con20_10.pdf, con21_02_e.pdf: Shionogi Inc. printed, no Fetroja line; FY2019 results (e_p200511.pdf): no Fetroja line.
Quarterly-trend tables in the FY2022-FY2025 supplements list Shionogi Inc. in total but not Fetroja, so no single-quarter figure is printed; quarters are derived from cumulative figures.
Other issuers: no partner prints U.S. Fetroja sales (Shionogi sells it itself in the U.S.); not searched further because Shionogi's own documents cover every quarter of the span.
